title: LED Work Lights 4-Pack – 3.3" Spotlight 12/24V
descriptionHtml:
Extra light all around the vehicle

A single light is rarely enough to light up everything around the vehicle. With several smaller lights you get light exactly where you need it.

Four compact spotlights

This 4-pack of 3.3-inch LED lights gives a strong spot beam and runs on 12V or 24V. They are small, tough and easy to mount in several places.

Features

  • 4-pack of 3.3-inch LED lights
  • Strong spot beam
  • Runs on 12V or 24V
  • Water-resistant and durable
  • Great for jeeps, trucks, 4x4s and SUVs

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
